title: MicroQuickJS (mquickjs) before commit 99eed3f contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability because JS_Call() raises…
description: MicroQuickJS (mquickjs) versions before commit 99eed3f have an out-of-bounds read vulnerability. This occurs because JS_Call() raises exceptions during frame setup without updating internal stack pointers, allowing crafted JavaScript to cause the engine to crash, resulting in denial of service.
